newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal buys escudos for marks - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal buys escudos for marks - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal intervened in the foreign exchange market in support of the escudo on Wednesday, selling marks at 101.23 escudos, dealers said.
"There was a persistent offer of marks at 101.22 and 101.23 escudos and everything points to the Bank of Portugal. It allowed the currency to recover," said one trader.
The escudo was trading at 101.17/20, having opened at 100.93/96.
"There was an initial offer of marks by the Bank at 101.20 but that was quickly absorbed by the market," said another trader.
Bank of Portugal officials declined to comment on the reported intervention.
